shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations, finished-art blueprints (§74) + wall risers (§75 a-f: no research, regrouped architect order, all carrier art hidden in normal view). Workshop 3776015553. Owed: relaunch verify, final riser art, smoke test, notes-paste, §70, upstream paste.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (survives in git history pre-a50a744). ~117 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

All three built, none launched. Only bridge error all session = known-benign Rimefeller dds. Workspace dll DEBUG. ⚠ Rule 29 (w9): utility run + notes paste never separately confirmed.

**GIT:** `Astryls/As-above-So-below`, `main`, `eb3dad9` pushed. Autosave active. This session's work (§74, §75 a-f, temp art) NOT manually committed - **checkpoint next session if autosave missed it; this is now a large uncommitted delta.**

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits; §75 temp set = explicit user-ordered TEMPORARY exception; render_svg_to_png otherwise = flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER; MESH AND OVERLAYS ARE SEPARATE METHODS. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW.

# 62. UTILITY COLUMN REWORK — SHIPPED. Anatomy + §45 up-cell rule as prior revisions. **Hide machinery, final shape (§75.e):** `Patch_SectionLayer_ABHideCarrierUnderColumn.ShouldPrint` is now ONE clause - `IsCarrier(t.def)` → never print. All positional logic (in-cell walk, below-cell band math) DELETED; the prefix no longer touches the thing grid, which also removes it from the render hot path's cost. Installed on vanilla `SectionLayer_ThingsGeneral` + the Dubs-family layers via `ABForeignPipeLayerHide` (DBH SectionLayer_ThingsSewagePipe; Rimefeller SectionLayer_ThingsPipe + SectionLayer_SewagePipe; Rimatomics SectionLayer_ThingsPipe; name-resolved, map-comp anchors shared with DubsPipeCompat.Hosts, rule-33 warning if a host loads with zero patched layers, `__0` index binding). ⚠ Overlays NEVER patched (vanilla power grid, VEF SectionLayer_Resource [verified frame-gated overlay-only in the 1.6 assembly], Dubs *Overlay layers) - rule 34, and they are now the ONLY place carriers are visible.

# 63-73 — unchanged.

# 75. WALL RISERS, SCOPE A — BUILT (a-f) + TEMP ART; d/e/f RELAUNCH PENDING; FINAL ART PAUSED

Core record as prior revisions (4 defs, riser IS Building_ABColumn, WallLamp attachment mechanics, no holdsRoof, cascade despawn, north-face uiIconPaths).

**Field-fix chain, every one driven by a live run:** **a** own-cell stub read as stray conduit → unconditional in-cell hide. **b** up-cell stub above risers → below-cell attachment clause. **c** inspect line advertised toggles that cannot exist in a vanilla-only session → `TypeHasNetworks()` + `AB2_ColumnInspect_NoNetworks`. **d** Dubs-family layers bypassed the hide entirely (decompiled PipeSystem/DBH/Rimefeller/Rimatomics to find them) → `ABForeignPipeLayerHide`. **e** user revoked §62.J → ShouldPrint collapsed to one unconditional clause. **f** user removed the build gate + fixed menu placement:
- **NO researchPrerequisites** on `AB_ColumnBase` or `AB_WallRiserBase` (were Electricity + Machining). Core infrastructure, not a tech reward. ⚠ The PER-NETWORK connect toggles still respect each host mod's research (`AB2_ColumnNeedsResearch`), so an unresearched network still cannot be carried.
- **ARCHITECT ORDER.** Vanilla Structure is Wall 2000 / doors 2010 / Fence 2020 / FenceGate 2030 / Column 2040 / AnimalFlap 2050. The seven vertical links had NO explicit uiOrder and inherited **DoorBase's 2010**, interleaving them with the vanilla doors - the actual placement bug. Now: links **2060-2066** (ladder down/up, stairs down/up, grand down/up, elevator), columns **2070-2073**, risers **2080-2083**, so the whole mod forms one deliberate block after vanilla's. (`DesignationCategoryDef.ResolveDesignators` reads `uiOrder`; it is also the dropdown Order key.)

⚠ Doctrine: the riser promise is NO loose plumbing in normal view ANYWHERE, on EVERY host's print path (rule 16); overlays carry connectivity (rule 34); the §62.M-era assumption "foreign pipe layers are overlays" is DEAD - always decompile before classifying a foreign layer.

**TEMP ART:** as prior revisions (12 PNGs, top-down plate + under-passing run, palette read off the real columns). **FINAL ART - GEMINI PAUSED r5.** **OFFERED NOT ACCEPTED:** DesignatorDropdownGroupDefs to collapse 15 AB2 buttons into 3 dropdowns.
